`ground-street.png` is the unmodified demo photo from the official NVIDIA
SegFormer repository: https://github.com/NVlabs/SegFormer/blob/master/demo/demo.png
It is used only as an automated semantic-ground regression input. It is not
included in public/ or the production build. Upstream license:
https://github.com/NVlabs/SegFormer/blob/master/LICENSE
